verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a public Management HTTP API with a full OpenAPI 3.0 reference at docs.jitsu.com/api, covering workspaces, destinations, connections, syncs and functions. Nothing shows that reference is interactive (try-it-out) or ships runnable examples. The probe found no raw OpenAPI spec at the standard candidate paths, though that does not contradict the reference page itself. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable request examples, a fetchable machine-readable spec, and independent corroboration.
